messages:
Alex: heads-up — found a 404 in the runtime guide when previewing staging. the TOC link to the batching section (https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/runtime/batching#continuous-batching) 404s
Jamie: thanks, can you paste the exact path you clicked?
Alex: clicked from the runtime TOC -> runtime/batching and the fragment '#continuous-batching' seems missing after the refactor last week.
Docs-bot: link-scan: detected broken fragment in /runtime/batching (staging). created ticket KB-421.
Marta: @Alex good catch — I think the anchor id was renamed to 'continuous-batching-v2' in the schema cleanup PR (3245).
Alex: ok — simplest fix is update the TOC link to the new fragment, or add an explicit anchor alias. small PR should do it.
Priya: happy to review a small PR. please include a quick changelog frontmatter note so reviewers see it's safe.
Alex: opened PR: https://git.internal.redwood.io/docs/pr/7821 — updates TOC link and adds a short frontmatter changelog. added a tiny preview test. sed snippet I used locally:
```bash
git checkout -b fix/docs/batching-anchor
sed -i 's/#continuous-batching/#continuous-batching-v2/g' content/runtime/batching.md
git commit -am "docs: update batching anchor for staging preview"
git push origin fix/docs/batching-anchor
```
Jamie: scanned the diff, looks minimal. @Priya ping for final signoff.
Priya: quick pass — tiny nit: add 1 line to frontmatter: "changelog: fix anchor" so release notes capture it. otherwise LGTM. :thumbsup:
Alex: updated PR with the changelog line and added the preview assertion that the fragment exists. bumped for review.
Marta: will merge once CI completes. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
Docs-bot: PR 7821 merged to main by Marta. staging preview re-triggered.
Alex: confirmed staging now resolves the anchor and the page loads. closing KB-421. thanks! :tada:
